Sustainable Fabric Innovations for a Greener Textile Industry # In the modern era, the manufacturing sector is a significant source of carbon emissions, making sustainability a central concern for responsible businesses. At Yi Chun Textile, we recognize the importance of corporate social responsibility and are dedicated to minimizing our environmental footprint. Our ongoing efforts focus on developing and supplying innovative sustainable fabric solutions, with a particular emphasis on recycled PET (rPET) and recycled nylon fabrics.
Eco-friendly textile production Eco icon Recycled Polyester (rPET): Transforming the Textile Landscape # Recycled polyester, or rPET, is at the forefront of the textile industry’s shift toward sustainability. Traditionally, polyester has been valued for its cost-effectiveness and versatility. Today, it is being reimagined through the use of recycled materials. By converting discarded plastic bottles and virgin polyester waste into new yarn, rPET offers a way to:
Reduce reliance on virgin plastics Lower carbon emissions Align with the values of environmentally conscious consumers Meet evolving environmental regulations Maintain the performance and quality expected from polyester fabrics As a supplier of sustainable fabrics, Yi Chun provides high-quality rPET textiles to partners worldwide, enabling brands to adopt eco-friendly alternatives without sacrificing durability or style.
The Circular Benefits of Recycled PET Fabric # Recycled PET fabric embodies a circular approach to sustainability. The process involves either melting and re-spinning plastic bottles into robust yarn or chemically breaking down and reforming polyester molecules. This approach not only diverts plastic waste from oceans and landfills but also reduces greenhouse gas emissions.
Key advantages of recycled PET fabric include:
Exceptional durability and performance Strong elasticity and resistance to heat Retention of moisture and color The ability to be recycled multiple times with minimal loss of quality Yi Chun’s rPET fabrics are well-suited for eco-friendly fashion, sportswear, accessories, and bags, making them a preferred choice for brands committed to sustainability.
Advancements in Recycled Nylon Fabric # Recycled nylon represents another significant step forward in sustainable textiles. It is produced from post-industrial waste, such as leftover yarns and scrap fabrics, as well as discarded fishing nets and other industrial materials. Compared to virgin nylon, recycled nylon fabric can reduce CO₂ emissions by up to 18% while retaining all the desirable properties of traditional nylon:
Lightweight and strong Abrasion-resistant Quick-drying Versatile for use in bags, backpacks, outerwear, and swimwear At Yi Chun, we are dedicated to supplying recycled nylon fabrics that meet rigorous environmental and quality standards. Why Eco-Friendly Nylon Fabric Matters – Read the Full Story
Recycle PET Recycle Nylon Fabric The Importance of Eco-Friendly Fabrics # Opting for eco-friendly fabrics such as rPET and recycled nylon helps to:
Conserve non-renewable resources Minimize plastic waste pollution Reduce carbon footprints throughout the supply chain Support a more sustainable and responsible textile and fashion industry As an experienced manufacturer of eco-friendly textiles, Yi Chun empowers brands to make responsible material choices. Our products deliver performance, style, and innovation while meeting international safety standards, including OEKO-TEX® certification.

Advanced Functional Treatments for Textile Performance # With a strong foundation in supply chain integration, Yi Chun Textile collaborates with both upstream and downstream partners to deliver a diverse range of competitive textile products. All offerings are OEKO-TEX® certified, ensuring a commitment to safety, quality, and sustainability.
Below is an overview of the high-performance fabric finishing treatments available:
Color Fastness Water Proof & Water Repellent Hydrostatics Moisture Ventilation Permeability Anti-UV Flame Retardant Anti-Mildew and Antibacterial with Deodorization Anti-Cold Anti-Scratch Peach Anti-cracking Anti-static Color Fastness # Our fabrics demonstrate excellent color fastness, maintaining their appearance through washing, abrasion, and exposure to sunlight.
Water Proof & Water Repellent (PFAS-free Formulations) # We utilize eco-friendly C6 and C8 water repellent technologies, applied through rigorous manufacturing processes. This ensures a durable water-repellent effect that withstands repeated washing.
Hydrostatics # Hydrostatics is an alternative developed to address the high processing costs of water-pressure PU. It is suitable for use in fabric lamination and as a backing layer, providing additional performance options.
Moisture Ventilation Permeability # Our solutions promote breathability by allowing air to reach the skin and enabling sweat to evaporate, addressing common production challenges related to moisture management.
Anti-UV # Anti-UV treatments offer strong durability against harsh weather, making them ideal for outdoor and marine applications. These treatments are widely used in products such as masks, tents, canvas, and yacht materials.
Flame Retardant # Fabrics are treated with flame retardants, coatings, or laminates to achieve flame resistance, meeting the needs of various consumer and industrial applications.
Anti-Mildew and Antibacterial with Deodorization # Antifungal treatments inhibit the growth of fungi on textiles. Antibacterial finishes are especially valuable for medical textiles, while deodorization reduces odor by minimizing exposure to odor-causing gases.
Anti-Cold # Standard PVC sheets without additives can become brittle and crack below 33°F. By incorporating cold-crack additives, we enhance the durability of PVC sheets in extreme conditions, with performance tailored to material hardness.
Anti-Scratch # Protective coatings or films are applied to fabric surfaces to reduce the risk of scratches and extend product lifespan.
Peach # Peach processing creates microfibers on the fabric surface, resulting in a soft, pleasant touch.
Anti-cracking # Anti-cracking treatments minimize seam slippage, particularly beneficial for lining fabrics and similar applications.
Anti-static # Anti-static resin treatments are applied to fabric surfaces to improve their resistance to static electricity.
For further details or to discuss custom finishing solutions, please contact us.

Expertise and Considerations in Horse Wear Fabric # Horse blankets, also known as horse gear or horse clothing, are specialized garments crafted to provide protection, comfort, and sometimes aesthetic appeal for horses. The creation of these products demands a blend of textile knowledge, technical skill, and an understanding of equine needs. Below, we outline the essential aspects that define quality horse wear fabric and the expertise required in their production.
Key Areas of Horse Blanket Fabrication # Fabric Selection and Functionality
Durability: Horse blankets must endure daily friction, changing weather, and the horse’s active movements. Selecting fabrics with high durability is crucial. Textile professionals assess fiber properties such as water resistance, UV protection, and breathability to ensure optimal performance. Comfort: The material should be gentle on the horse’s skin, minimizing friction and preventing heat buildup. Understanding the comfort characteristics of various fabric structures is essential, especially for materials in direct contact with the animal. Breathability and Moisture-Wicking: Since horses sweat during activity, fabrics must be breathable and capable of wicking moisture to maintain comfort. Cutting and Structural Design
The design must accommodate the horse’s anatomy and movement. Skilled tailoring ensures a custom fit that does not restrict movement or cause discomfort. Flexibility and adjustability, such as the use of Velcro or straps, are important for adapting the blanket to different horses.
Sewing and Reinforcement Techniques
Horse blankets are subject to pulling and wear, especially with active or training horses. Professional sewing and reinforcement of seams and key areas are necessary to maintain stability and durability.
Functional Materials and Advanced Fabrics
Modern horse blankets often incorporate high-tech fibers with special properties, such as antimicrobial or hypoallergenic features, and fabrics with integrated warming or cooling capabilities. Familiarity with these materials allows textile professionals to select the right fabric for various environments and needs.
Producing horse wear requires a deep understanding of fabric selection, structural design, sewing techniques, and functional materials. This level of professionalism and experience is essential for delivering products that meet the demands of both horses and their owners. Yi Chun continues to offer customization services to meet specific requirements. For further information, please feel free to contact us.

Mesh Fabrics: Versatility and Performance for Modern Applications # Mesh fabric stands apart from traditional tightly woven textiles due to its open, loose weave that forms thousands of tiny holes across the surface. This distinctive structure ensures excellent breathability and airflow, making mesh fabrics particularly suitable for warm and humid climates found in regions such as the Middle East, Southern Europe, and America.
Our mesh fabrics are engineered for both durability and strength, allowing them to withstand demanding daily use. This combination of ventilation and resilience makes mesh fabric an ideal choice for a wide range of products that require comfort and long-lasting performance in diverse global markets.

The structure of mesh fabric allows for efficient airflow, helping to keep users cool and dry even in challenging environments.

Understanding the Versatility of Nylon Fabrics # Nylon fabric, crafted from nylon fibers, stands out for its remarkable flexibility, alkali resistance, and superior abrasion resistance. Produced by melting and spinning thiamine caprolactam (CPL), nylon offers a lightweight alternative to many other textiles. Its excellent moisture absorption, easy maintenance, and silky hand feel make it a preferred material for a wide range of uses. For those seeking a unique texture, crinkle nylon fabric provides a distinct look and feel.
Chemical Composition and Main Types # Nylon, chemically known as polyamide, is derived from petroleum products and is among the most widely used synthetic fibers in industrial production. The two primary types of nylon fabric are:
Nylon 6 Nylon 66 These fabrics can be enhanced with various backing treatments, including TPU / PVC, PVC sponge, PU, TPE, TPU, NEO, hydrostatic film, WR, and WP, depending on the requirements of the final product.
Classification by Denier (D) # Nylon fabrics are categorized by their thickness and intended application. The denier rating helps determine the fabric’s suitability for different uses. Yi Chun offers a comprehensive range of nylon fabrics, including:
Under 70 D 70D - 200D 400D – 800D 1000D – 2520D TASLON OTHERS Under 70 D: Thin and lightweight, ideal for delicate applications. 70D - 200D: Medium thickness, suitable for general-purpose uses. 400D – 800D: Thicker fabric for heavy-duty applications. 1000D – 2520D: Designed for extreme conditions and heavy-duty use. TASLON: Known for high tenacity and elasticity. OTHERS: Includes specialty nylon fabrics with unique treatments. A notable example is the Nylon 70D Fabric, a TPU / PVC waterproof fabric that balances durability and lightness, making it ideal for rainwear and outdoor gear.
Applications of Nylon Fabric # Nylon’s strength, durability, and adaptability make it a popular choice across various industries and products:
Clothing and Outdoor Gear: Jackets, raincoats, shoes, hats, umbrellas, and parasols Travel and Luggage: Luggage, backpacks, school bags, laptop bags, and ladies’ bags Outdoor Goods: Tents, outdoor equipment Industrial Uses: Automotive parts, linings Home and Medical Use: Home decoration, medical supplies Specialty Items: Photography equipment softbox fabric, covers, and concealment materials Yi Chun: Your Partner for Custom Nylon Fabric Solutions # Why Choose Yi Chun for Custom Nylon Fabrics? # Yi Chun is a leading manufacturer and supplier of custom nylon fabrics, offering a broad selection to meet diverse requirements. The product range spans from lightweight (20D) to heavy-duty (2520D) options, suitable for various weaving styles such as plain, twill, ripstop, and jacquard (dobby).
Our Capabilities # Production Scale: Yi Chun produces and sells 3 million meters of nylon fabric monthly. Customization: Tailored nylon fabrics are available to meet specific client needs. Efficiency: The company is dedicated to minimizing shipping time and costs, ensuring prompt delivery. For those seeking a reliable and experienced Taiwan nylon fabric manufacturer, Yi Chun offers high-quality textiles and attentive service. Contact Us Today for Custom Nylon Fabric Solutions!

Introduction to T/C Fabric # T/C fabric, also known as Tetoron Cotton, is a blend of polyester and cotton fibers. This material is recognized for its breathability, pleasant hand-feel, and resistance to moisture and mold. The term “Tetoron” originated in Japan over 40 years ago as a name for polyester. Today, T/C fabric typically consists of 65% polyester and 35% cotton, combining the strengths of both fibers.
Key Features of T/C Fabric # Durability and Strength: T/C fabric offers excellent tensile strength, making it suitable for a wide range of applications. Color Fastness: The blend ensures that colors remain vibrant and do not fade easily over time. Easy Care: T/C fabrics are less prone to creasing and maintain their form well, simplifying maintenance and care. Breathability: The cotton component enhances comfort by allowing air circulation, while polyester adds resilience. Types of T/C Fabrics # The T/C fabric range includes several varieties to meet different needs:
T/C Twill T/C Pocketing T/C Lining T/C Fleece T/C Jersey Customization Services # Yi Chun Textile offers customization services for T/C fabrics, allowing clients to specify their requirements for unique applications. For further details or to discuss your project, please contact us.

At Yi Chun Textile, we specialize in producing high-quality TPU / PVC fabric sheets, engineered to meet the diverse needs of industries ranging from sportswear to automotive and commercial applications.

Abrasion Resistance and Lightweight: These materials are known for their durability and light weight, making them ideal for demanding environments. Versatile Applications: Commonly referred to as “Vinyl” in Europe and the US, TPU / PVC fabrics are synthetic technical fabrics suitable for: Equipment covers Sports clothing Space vehicles Military Commercial tents Automotive components Advertising banners, awnings, and covers Product Range # Yi Chun offers a comprehensive selection of flexible TPU / PVC plastic sheets, including:
